entries.clue: "The sum is greater than the parts" philosophy
1963 film based on a Larry McMurtry novel
It ends "...and peaceful slept the mighty Hector's shade"
Alternative to "Ticket" in a highway safety campaign
It merged with Air France in 2004
Cause of a shot in the dark?
Advice for an out-of-shape guy trying to attract women?
Series centered at the Washington Navy Yard
On the left side of the no. line
Company whose first store was in Aelmhult, Sweden
Result of a cloudy day at the beach?
